title: Isospectral Steering
summary: We study the controllability of the differential Lyapunov equation under isospectral rotation of a linear gradient field. Specifically, control is effected by a symmetric time-varying gain-matrix constrained to have fixed eigenvalues; that is, by exclusively modulating the eigen-vectors of the state matrix and not its eigenvalues. Motivation for this problem stems from a certain type of control objectives (minimum shear/attention) aimed to reduce anisotropic deformation when ensembles are steered by a common law--optimality necessitates constancy of eigenvalues.
